skill.name: cursor-mem
skill.description: Use Cursor with claude-mem MCP to search past session records and record project observations for shared coding context.
skill.summary: Share searchable claude-mem project memory between Cursor, Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown inline code, local documentation links, and Japanese prose entropy. Confirmed risks involve persistent hidden SQLite memory storage, manual troubleshooting commands, and broad tool permissions. No prompt injection or remote data exfiltration evidence was found.

remediation.suggestion: Remove Bash unless it is required, and list exact claude-mem MCP tools instead of a wildcard.

remediation.issue: Persistent memory database may store sensitive context
remediation.suggestion: Document retention, cleanup, and secret handling rules for the claude-mem SQLite database.
Tell users to verify script paths and file contents before running chmod or node commands.

remediation.issue: Wildcard plugin cache path in node command
remediation.suggestion: Replace the wildcard with a resolved versioned path and explain how users can validate it.

content.value_statement: Project decisions often disappear between AI coding sessions. This skill connects Cursor to claude-mem so teams can search, reuse, and record shared coding context.
actual_capabilities: Search claude-mem records from Cursor by keyword.
Retrieve timelines, recent context, and specific observations.
Record observations, entities, and relations through claude-mem MCP tools.
Apply shared tags for Cursor and Claude Code records.
Configure Cursor to launch a local claude-mem MCP server.
Troubleshoot local worker startup and health checks.
limitations: Requires an existing claude-mem installation and local MCP setup.
Does not include the claude-mem server implementation.
Stored memory may contain sensitive project context.
Should not be loaded for routine coding tasks without memory needs.

use_cases.title: Recover Architecture Decisions
use_cases.description: Search past decisions before changing authentication, data models, or deployment patterns.

use_cases.title: Capture Review Findings
use_cases.description: Record review notes, reusable patterns, and handoff items from Cursor sessions.

use_cases.title: Transfer Context Between Tools
use_cases.description: Share implementation context between Cursor, Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Past Decision
prompt_templates.prompt: Search claude-mem for the reason we selected the current authentication approach.

prompt_templates.title: Record a Review Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Record this review finding in claude-mem with source:cursor and type:review tags.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a handoff observation for the backend error handling work and tag it for Claude Code.

prompt_templates.title: Reconstruct Project Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Search recent claude-mem context, timeline entries, and related observations for the payment flow refactor.

output_examples.output: Found a decision record explaining why the team chose Supabase Auth over a custom JWT flow.

output_examples.input: Record a reusable RLS policy pattern.
output_examples.output: Saved a pattern note with Cursor source, review context, RLS tags, and the rationale for future searches.
Returned recent handoff notes about backend error handling and the files that need follow-up.

best_practices: Record why a decision was made, not only what changed.
Use consistent source and type tags for every memory entry.
Review memory content before storing secrets or private customer data.
anti_patterns: Do not store credentials, tokens, or customer secrets in memory records.
Do not load the skill when the task does not need shared memory.
Do not run troubleshooting commands before verifying local script paths.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It connects Cursor workflows to a local claude-mem MCP server.

faq.question: Does it send memory to a remote service?
faq.answer: The documentation describes local storage, but users should verify their claude-mem setup.

faq.question: Can it write new memory entries?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents tools for adding observations, entities, and relations.

faq.question: Is this only for Claude Code?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to share context between Cursor and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Users need claude-mem installed and a Cursor MCP configuration that points to the local wrapper script.

faq.question: What data should not be stored?
faq.answer: Do not store passwords, tokens, private customer data, or other secrets.
